text: The unique and complex considerations of digital asset custody reports that digital assets had matured as an asset class with increasing adoption among retail and institutional investors. This qualifies Kaal's custody-dependent account of institutional restraint by documenting adoption rather than categorical exclusion. The abstract does not identify the custody arrangements used, measure adoption, or show that institutions can participate without reliable custody solutions.
